meta.name: shadcn
meta.description: Manages shadcn components and projects — adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. Provides project context, component docs, and usage examples. Applies when working with shadcn/ui, component registries, presets, --preset codes, or any project with a components.json file. Also triggers for "shadcn init", "create an app with --preset", or "switch to --preset".

copy.tagline: 管理 shadcn 组件和项目，添加、搜索、修复、调试和组合 UI
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 shadcn/ui 构建 React 界面，需要管理组件和项目配置
copy.tagline_en: Manage shadcn components and projects, add, search, fix, debug, and compose UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build React UIs with shadcn/ui and need to manage components and project config

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你管理 shadcn UI 组件：添加、搜索、修复、调试、样式和组合界面，包括聊天界面。它会提供项目上下文、组件文档和使用示例，并确保代码遵循 shadcn 的最佳实践。
howto.when: 当你在处理包含 components.json 文件的项目，或提到 shadcn init、--preset 代码、组件注册表时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加一个按钮组件到项目中。
say.note: Claude 会运行 CLI 命令添加组件。

say.text: 搜索可用的对话框组件。
say.note: Claude 会搜索注册表并返回结果。

say.text: 帮我修复表单组件的验证样式。
say.note: Claude 会检查代码并应用正确的验证属性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps manage shadcn UI components: adding, searching, fixing, debugging, styling, and composing UI, including chat interfaces. It provides project context, component docs, and usage examples, ensuring code follows shadcn best practices.
howto.when_en: Triggered when working on a project with a components.json file, or when mentioning shadcn init, --preset codes, or component registries.

say_en.text: Add a button component to the project.
say_en.note: Claude runs the CLI command to add the component.
Claude searches registries and returns results.

say_en.text: Fix the validation styling on the form component.
say_en.note: Claude inspects code and applies correct validation attributes.
